hints.title: Group Consecutive Characters
hints.text: A contiguous run of length L identical characters contains L * (L + 1) / 2 homogenous substrings.

hints.title: Running Streak Counter
hints.text: Iterate through string maintaining current character run length: increment streak if character repeats, else reset to 1.

hints.title: Accumulate with Modulo
hints.text: Add current streak length to the answer at each step modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and checking all O(n^2) substrings takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear running streak accumulation evaluates total in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that adding current streak length on every character naturally sums L * (L + 1) / 2.

solutions.approach: Running streak length incremental summation modulo 10^9 + 7
